title: Verify peer identity for encrypted connections
summary: Transport encryption must validate the peer certificate and hostname so encryption does not silently connect to an untrusted endpoint.
review_checks: Find disabled certificate verification and permissive TLS callbacks.
Confirm development exceptions cannot reach production configuration.
safe_tests: Use local test certificates and an untrusted test issuer.
Confirm the connection fails when verification is enabled.
remediation: Enable default certificate and hostname verification.
Use explicit trust configuration only for scoped test environments.
